playback_hint.inverse_seek_algorithm: binary search lookup_points.scroll_progress then interpolate master frame, choose the video group of selected displayed frame; seek by selected exact frame.web_pts_ticks/15360; do not interpolate across different video groups within one video element
playback_hint.reverse_scroll: use same monotonic table in both directions
playback_hint.group_boundary_mode: switch video sources at boundary to target group frame 0, never seek previous group at out-of-range time
playback_hint.seam_semantics: synthetic scroll bridging, not inferred physical optical flow

reference.reference_selection: PASS1 VALID same-method within-source pairs excluding authored S00_S10

density_definition: dimensionless positive scroll distance needed to advance one adjacent displayed frame; frame_advance_multiplier=1/density
